needed.evidence: No continuous purpose-built sidewalk; people and goods occupy a narrow strip beside the lane.
needed.suggestion: Provide a continuous 1.5 m footway on the left, set back from the kerb, to separate pedestrians from traffic.

needed.evidence: No usable sidewalk; a person stands in the roadway edge beside parked vehicles.
needed.suggestion: Construct a 1.5 m footway on the right to give pedestrians a safe place away from the carriageway.

needed.evidence: Uneven, broken paving and debris along the informal path.
needed.suggestion: Resurface and level the left-side path to remove trip hazards.

needed.evidence: Rough, uneven ground and scattered items along the right edge.
needed.suggestion: Resurface and level the right-side path to remove trip hazards.

needed.evidence: High crossing demand from shops and people on both sides, but no marked or signalised crossing is visible.
needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing with dropped kerbs at the busiest point to give a safe place to cross.
